sources.title: City — Prince’s Island Park
sources.facts: Eastern constructed wetland, learning pathway, picnic areas, playground and flower gardens.

sources.title: CMLC — St. Patrick’s Island
sources.facts: Restored 31-acre habitat, channels, trails, amphitheatre, play areas and nine-metre Rise. Completed 2015. Official visitor photographs inspected; not runtime textures.

sources.title: W Architecture — St. Patrick’s Island
sources.facts: Built habitat/channel/boardwalk design informs shore placement. Furniture dimensions remain illustrative.

sources.title: City — Wild animals in Calgary’s natural areas
sources.facts: Beavers are part of Calgary’s waterway ecology; runtime animals are authored habitat illustrations, not tracked individuals.

sources.title: Government of Alberta — Rabbits and hares
sources.facts: Native rabbits/hares; brown-grey summer and seasonal white hare coats. Long ears and large hind legs inform original model.

sources.title: Government of Alberta — Geese
sources.facts: Canada geese use urban habitats; model has black neck/head/beak with white cheek/chin and grey-brown wing pattern.

sources.title: Tillett Lighting — St. Patrick’s Island
sources.facts: Low shielded lighting preserves dark habitat; wildlife overlay adds no spotlights or high-intensity park lighting.
